1. **PAINTLIVE-0606 (req_0080)** — USER RULING, verbatim: "painting with the shader on the painter doesnt make sense if the model doesnt have an active effect texture also. so? pick one, and pick the one where the model can get the live texture." Built, verified, UNCOMMITTED (awaits its own commit pass).
2. **CUTOUTFLIP-0606 (req_0153)** — USER RULING, verbatim: "cutout needs work but its at least got everything from the route in there so its g2g nuke that shit." **COMMITTED + PUSHED: `12d36473c`** (includes the BENCHHINT-0606 crash fix, req_0185).

Your job: shepherd the uncommitted waves to their commits as the supervisor sequences them, relay the FOOTMESH proof to the user, and fix forward anything their live testing surfaces.

## Constraints, conventions, and gotchas

- Build/verify ONLY via `tools/rjit` (`game verify`, `shot`, `ship`); never `scripts/*`, never node/bun. `SHIP_RUN_PACKAGE=0 ./tools/rjit ship hmsc-int` = fast binary.
- The user runs their own dev host with an auto-push watcher — edit and stop; framework/ Zig changes need a ship, TSX hot-reloads.
- SELFSHOT only (`rjit shot`) — desktop capture is BANNED. Cite full image paths, never bare filenames.
- Commit to main only, explicit paths only (shared index, parallel sessions). No subagents, ever (CLAUDE.md hard rule).
- The real React error at a crash hides behind the boundary: run `ZIGOS_HEADLESS=1 RJIT_BOOT_ROUTE=<route> ./zig-out/bin/hmsc-int 2>&1` and grep `react-uncaught` — that's how BENCHHINT was found.
- Headless camera angles cannot be seeded via twigs (CAMFOCUS boot-framing overrides); crop the app's own capture instead.
- `tools/oracle "<query>"` FIRST for any game-side decision; the maintenance contract: documented-cart edits update `docs/game/<cart>.md` + `_index/records/` in the same commit.
- Globe law: profile is RADIAL-only, length = scaleY alone (shiftZ/floorY were added without violating it — keep it that way).

## What comes next (after this handoff's task is done)

- The user's verdict may spawn FOOTMESH tuning (dial defaults) or a shoe-overlay follow-up (the old preset comment said "shoe overlays provide the readable front volume" — none exist yet).
- PAINTLIVE's honest caveat for a future lane: effects animate live on the painter canvas but freeze at bake inside `StaticSurface` captures on models — a re-bake clock for animated looks is an open idea, perf-risky (see memory `hmsc_idle_physics_rerender_storm`).
- req_0003 (painter shaders vs game materials unification) is OPEN and partially surfaced by PAINTLIVE — the shader-language unification still needs a user ruling.

## How to report back

READY reports to the supervisor pane per dispatch; commits only when the supervisor instructs, one logical change each, pushed to main, sha posted. FOOTMESH is done ONLY when the user's eyes pass the feet. PAINTLIVE is done when its commit lands and req_0080 is resolved with the sha.
